subject: Access & vetting artifacts — personnel certification log for SIG review
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@northbridge.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Personnel certification log & background screening confirmation

Hi Stephanie,

We're kicking off a SIG questionnaire for an upcoming procurement review and need to validate a few personnel controls tied to onboarding/offboarding and training. Can you send the following items by end of next week (EOD 2027-09-21)?

- A roster (CSV) showing mandatory security training completion dates for all Redwood employees who had access to customer production systems over Q2–Q3 2027.
- A signed statement from your background-check vendor confirming screening scope (criminal, identity, and employment verification) and approximate turnaround time.
- A short narrative describing your offboarding process (how access is revoked, typical time-to-revoke, audit logging locations).

If there are PII concerns, redacted/sampled exports are fine; we just need enough evidence to map controls to SIG items. Also please include any sample offboarding entries (log excerpts) you can share.

Would you be available for a 30-minute call Thursday to walk through artifacts? Sam Patel from Procurement will join.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Nguyen
Head of Security Reviews
Northbridge Systems

Attachments referenced: none in this message.
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@northbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Personnel certification log & background screening confirmation

Alice — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the items you listed. Quick summary of what I'm attaching and the cadence: 

1) training_roster_Q3_2027.csv — includes employee name, role, completion date, and training module version. We will redact employee IDs and location fields where PII is sensitive; let me know if you need full usernames for sampling.
2) bg_vendor_statement.pdf — a letter from our vendor confirming scope and that checks were completed for hires since Jan 2026.

High-level offboarding narrative (summary):
- Deprovisioning is driven from HR exit event in Workday -> automated deprovision job triggers access revoke to SSO, GCP, and internal tooling.
- Typical median time-to-revoke is 12 minutes for SSO sessions; full entitlement cleanup across systems completes within 6 hours.
- Audit logs are retained in our SIEM for 13 months; we can export sample corresponding entries.

I can also provide a small sample CSV of offboard log lines. If the reviewer needs specific columns (timestamps, account id, action), tell me which ones to include.

Thursday at 10:00 PT works for a walk-through; I invited Ben to confirm timing and to surface the offboard-runbook.

Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: training_roster_Q3_2027.csv (CSV, 2.1MB stub), bg_vendor_statement.pdf (PDF, 48KB stub)

Stephanie — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few follow-ups before the call: 

- For the offboard samples, can you provide 3 recent entries (redacted) that show timestamps for: termination event, SSO disable, and final entitlement cleanup? We need these to confirm the time window measured in your narrative.
- For the training roster, include a column that indicates which employees had production access (boolean) so we can sample only those individuals. If that's hard, a role column is fine and we'll filter by role.
- On the bg_vendor_statement, can your vendor confirm whether they perform international screening checks for APAC hires? That's specifically flagged by our legal team.

If you can drop the sample offboard CSV and a short vendor note on APAC scope before the call, we can use the Thursday slot for quick clarifications instead of a long walkthrough.

Best,
Alice

Forwarding the thread and dropping a concise sample set for the SIG review. Ben and I prepared the offboard sample and the deprovision runbook excerpt.

SUMMARY (for reviewers):
- Offboard sample (offboard_audit_snapshot.csv): 3 redacted entries with event_time, user_role, sso_disabled_at, entitlement_cleanup_completed_at. Median delta between termination and sso_disable: 8 minutes; full cleanup median: 4.2 hours.
- Deprovision runbook (deprovision_runbook.md): steps triggered by HR exit event, playbook for emergency revoke, and verification checklist.
- Vendor note (bg_vendor_statement.pdf) included in the prior message; vendor confirmed international screening for hires in APAC, subject to local laws.

Ben — can you confirm the exact column names in the offboard export so I can send the final CSV to Northbridge? I redacted employee IDs and replaced them with redaction tokens (EMP-REDACT-XXX).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
